# Pinned dependencies for the terraform-prod-drift lints (#1324).
# Used by:
#   - .github/workflows/build-and-push.yml (Install python-hcl2 step)
#   - Makefile (lint-terraform-drift target — install hint)
# Bump in lockstep with python-hcl2 upstream releases.
python-hcl2==8.1.2

# pytest is here so the terraform-prod-drift-lint job can run the Auth0 Terraform
# fence (tests/scripts/test_auth0_not_terraform_managed.py), the one fence in the
# repo written as bare `def test_*` functions rather than unittest.TestCase.
# Pinned, not floating: that fence's whole guarantee rests on pytest's collection
# and exit semantics — exit 5 on zero collected is what stops a future rename from
# turning it into a silent no-op — and a major bump could move either. Listed here
# rather than installed inline so it shares the job's pip cache key, which is
# keyed on this file.
pytest==9.1.1
